These areas reflect research in industrial 3D sensing, intelligent robot control, and AI-driven automation.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $69,901,718, or 20.45% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $38,989,457 to $984,938,556, a 25.26x increase.
